description: Commission of Elections - Mr. Alawathupitiye Gedara Tikiri Banda elected as member of Hanguranketha Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Hanguranketha Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member. It involves the electoral process, nomination procedures, and declaration of a new member under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls squarely within the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections.
